messages.text:
Our top floor-standing pick is the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe. It's a large, hand-assembled, made-in-USA heirloom piece with a raised relief antique map that glows when lit, set on a handcrafted hardwood stand — a real centerpiece for a study or living room. You'll find it under that exact name in search, ready to add to your cart.

If you'd like the same antique look but in a slightly smaller floor size, the Replogle Freeport 16" Antique Ocean Raised Relief Globe is also a lovely hardwood-stand option.
